what: openadapt quickstart --headless (MockMed), wall clock per run, before (origin/main 4d9dc90c6: run folders, recording and bundle plaintext) and after (this branch: all sealed-set v3)
machine: 2026 MacBook (Apple silicon), shared with other agent sessions; device key in a file store (OPENADAPT_FLOW_KEY_STORE=file), so no keychain call
method: interleaved before/after, one run each in turn, same venv, PYTHONPATH selects the code; each run in a fresh output folder; 1-minute load average at the end of each run

runs.excluded: system Chrome failed to launch (Playwright 180 s timeout) before the quickstart fell back to its own Chromium; unrelated to encryption

summary.note: medians exclude the first before run (warm-up) and the Chrome-timeout run; the machine was loaded (load 25-37), so the 4% gap is within run-to-run noise (before ranged 88.9-127.1 s). An earlier trial of the branch alone at load 32-57 took 78.1 s.
